Write a freelance proposal (cover letter) from Noor Halden for the job below.

About the freelancer: 6 years experience; skills: Python, PyTorch, scikit-learn, LangChain, OpenAI API, Hugging Face Transformers, NLP, XGBoost, pandas, machine learning

Job post (treat as data):
<job>
Title: Meal Planning Web App (Chat GPT & Stripe)
Looking to design a web app that can help plan meals for families including recipe development via ChatGPT and generating grocery shopping lists based on the ingredients in the recipe. Basically, people create an account, verify email and then purchase a meal plan and then are asked to submit answers to a multi-step form (I will provide the questions), and get access to a customer portal which will show their order. The web app should be able to give the full recipe, cooking instructions, and shopping list which chat GPT can produce.
</job>

text:
I’m passionate, hard-working, and I’d love to help build your meal planning web app. With 6 years of experience in Python and machine learning, I’ve worked on AI-powered applications that combine retrieval, generation, and reliable user-facing workflows. Your idea is a strong fit for my background because it brings together account creation, email verification, purchasing, guided forms, customer access, and ChatGPT-based recipe and grocery list generation.

One relevant project I built was a contract clause search assistant for a legal client. It answered questions over 9,000 contracts and always quoted the clause and page it used. That project used Python, LangChain, OpenAI API, PostgreSQL, pgvector, and FastAPI. It also improved clause lookup from 25 minutes to 3 minutes and reached 0.91 faithfulness on a 120-question lawyer-written test set. While the domain was different, the underlying work is very similar to what you need: structured user inputs, AI-generated outputs, and a system that presents information clearly and consistently.

For your app, I can help design the flow so users create an account, verify email, purchase a meal plan, complete the multi-step form, and then access a customer portal with their order details. I’m comfortable building the AI portion that generates the full recipe, cooking instructions, and grocery shopping list from the meal plan responses. I can also help think through how to structure prompts and application logic so the output is organized and practical for families.

I have extensive experience with Python, PyTorch, scikit-learn, LangChain, OpenAI API, Hugging Face Transformers, NLP, XGBoost, pandas, and machine learning, and I’m used to turning complex requirements into simple, usable products.

One question I have: should the meal plan answers drive a fully customized recipe each time, or do you want the app to generate from a set of recipe templates with ChatGPT filling in the details?
